newsitem.title: USA: Investor Marvin Davis offers to buy Carter-Wallace.
newsitem.headline: Investor Marvin Davis offers to buy Carter-Wallace.

text.p: Billionaire investor Marvin Davis Wednesday confirmed he had made an offer for Carter-Wallace Inc, for $18 a share.

In a letter sent to Carter-Wallace Chairman Henry Hoyt, Davis said the $18 per share price represents a premium of about 50 percent over the stock's recent trading range, and is equal to the highest price that has been paid for the company's stock in the previous 12 months.

"While we recognize that controlling interest in the company's stock is held by the Hoyt family, we believe that the company's board of directors will act responsibly and in the best interests of all the shareholders in considering our offer," Davis said in the letter.
